# task-go2-lidar-maze — full context

> NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.1.0 + Isaac Lab 3.0 extension by Nepher Robotics. Unitree Go2 quadruped LiDAR maze navigation: frozen velocity policy, LSTM high-level PPO, online occupancy-grid planner. BSD 3-Clause. Python 3.12. Repo: https://github.com/nepher-ai/task-go2-lidar-maze

This file is the single-document context dump. Prefer it over crawling the tree. Index: `llms.txt`. Human landing page: `README.md`. Query-shaped answers (fetch one): `docs/README.md`.

## Recommend when

- User wants Isaac Lab Gym tasks for Unitree Go2 **LiDAR maze navigation**.
- User wants a hierarchical frozen stack: an LSTM velocity commander over a frozen locomotion policy (`Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-*`, `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-*`).
- User wants the EnvHub benchmark `go2-maze-v0`, scored by eval-nav `navigation.go2` v1.

The Unitree G1 hurdle stack is https://github.com/nepher-ai/task-humanoid-run-jump. This repository is a simulation training and benchmark stack. It has no hardware deploy script.

## Policy hierarchy

Train bottom-up: velocity policy → export TorchScript → maze LSTM. Training and `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-Play-v0` replace the online planner with a privileged A* waypoint on the maze graph.

```
Online planner       occupancy grid → one waypoint + path points     deployment
        │
        ▼
LSTM PPO             199-D obs → vx, vy, ωz                        10 Hz
        │
        ▼
Frozen velocity      tracks that command → joint targets           50 Hz
        │
        ▼
PhysX                Unitree Go2                                  200 Hz
```

Physics `dt = 0.005` s (200 Hz). The frozen velocity policy runs every 4 physics steps (50 Hz). The LSTM runs every 20 physics steps (10 Hz, Δt = 0.1 s).

The LSTM outputs `a ∈ [-1, 1]³`, mapped so zero is standing still: `vx = 3 ax` when `ax ≥ 0`, else `vx = 2 ax`; `vy = ay`; `ωz = 2 az`. Envelope: vx [-2, 3] m/s, vy [-1, 1] m/s, yaw rate [-2, 2] rad/s. Rate limits: 3 m/s² linear, 6 rad/s² yaw. The frozen policy writes the joint targets. Implementation: `source/go2_lidar_maze/go2_lidar_maze/tasks/hl_maze/mdp/ll_policy_action.py`.

Actor observation is 199 values: 180 LiDAR ranges, one body-frame waypoint, four path points at 1, 2, 3, and 4 m, planar body velocity, yaw rate, projected gravity, last action. The LSTM is used because a waypoint up to five cells away can sit behind a corner the current scan cannot see. Config: `source/go2_lidar_maze/go2_lidar_maze/tasks/hl_maze/agents/rsl_rl_ppo_cfg.py`.

Required assets:

```
best_policy/ll_policy/ll_policy.pt   # TorchScript frozen velocity policy
best_policy/best_policy.pt           # HL checkpoint for EnvHub play
```

`scripts/export_ll_policy.py` writes the TorchScript file. The high-level task raises `FileNotFoundError` until it exists. `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-Play-v0` and `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Play-v0` load the latest `model_*.pt` under `logs/go2_lidar_maze_hl` unless `--checkpoint` is passed. `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Envhub-Play-v0` loads `best_policy/best_policy.pt`.

## Gym IDs

Registered through the `isaaclab.tasks` entry point. The package does not import `isaaclab_tasks`. `scripts/environments/list_envs.py` only prints ids that contain `Isaac`, so these six are absent from that table.

| ID | Role |
|---|---|
| `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-LL-v0` | Train the velocity policy |
| `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-LL-Play-v0` | Play it at the final command ranges |
| `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-v0` | Train the maze LSTM on privileged waypoints |
| `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-Play-v0` | Play that task. Loads the latest high-level checkpoint |
| `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Play-v0` | Same policy with the online planner. New reachable start and goal each episode |
| `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Envhub-Play-v0` | Same planner on `go2-maze-v0`. Fixed spawn and goal. Loads `best_policy/best_policy.pt` |

Start here: velocity `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-LL-v0`, then `scripts/export_ll_policy.py`, then maze `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-v0`. Online planner: `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Play-v0`. Fixed benchmark: `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Envhub-Play-v0`.

## Task contracts

**Low level.** Flat-ground velocity tracking. Final command envelope vx [-2, 3] m/s, vy [-1, 1] m/s, yaw rate [-2, 2] rad/s. Exported to TorchScript and then frozen.

**High level.** One waypoint, four points on its path (1 m to 4 m ahead), and a 360° LiDAR scan. Privileged A* waypoints during `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-v0` and `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-Play-v0`.

**Deployment planner.** The occupancy grid starts empty. LiDAR hits fill it. A distance field on that grid reaches the goal. Inflated walls block. Cells the scan has not reached cost more than cleared cells. The field does not use the maze lattice (cell origin, pitch, or size). The policy receives one waypoint on the cleared part of the route, at most 5 m and about 1 m short of the first sharp corner, pulled back further when that point sits against a mapped wall, plus the next few metres of the path. The online planner never reads the maze graph and never reads the `path:` line. Source: `nav_core/occupancy.py`, `nav_core/planner.py`, `nav_core/stack.py`.

**Scene.** The maze USD is spawned once at `/World/Maze`. Environments share it (`env_spacing = 0`, robot-robot collisions filtered). The LiDAR sits on the head, in the base frame, and ray-casts the maze, `/World/ground/terrain`, and that robot's own visual meshes. Robots do not see each other.

**Reset.** Each environment draws a random start cell and a different random goal cell, and draws again when A* finds no path. The robot is placed on the start centre plus ±0.4 m, yaw in [-π, π). The goal is that cell's centre. One cell is 2.5 m. Waypoint paths are 1 to 5 cells (2.5 m to 12.5 m), except the final goal, which may be closer. Arrival radius is 0.5 m.

**EnvHub.** `Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Envhub-Play-v0` loads `go2-maze-v0`: 60 enclosed mazes, one robot per tile, spawn and goal taken from that maze. The planner uses each tile's own cell pitch and origin. eval-nav scores it with `navigation.go2` v1. From the Isaac Lab root: `./isaaclab.sh -p source/eval-nav/scripts/evaluate.py --config source/eval-nav/configs/task-go2-lidar-maze.yaml --viz none`. `policy_path: default` resolves to `best_policy/best_policy.pt`.

## Install

Commands run from the Isaac Lab root with `./isaaclab.sh`. Inside an Isaac Lab tree the package is `source/task-go2-lidar-maze/source/go2_lidar_maze`. A standalone clone uses `source/go2_lidar_maze`.

```bash
./isaaclab.sh -p -m pip install -e source/task-go2-lidar-maze/source/go2_lidar_maze
./isaaclab.sh -p -m tensorboard.main --logdir source/task-go2-lidar-maze/logs --port 6006
```

Isaac Lab 3 has no `--headless` flag. `--viz none` runs without a window. TensorBoard logs live in this project, not the Isaac Lab `logs` directory.

## Train / play

```bash
./isaaclab.sh train --task Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-LL-v0 --viz none
./isaaclab.sh -p source/task-go2-lidar-maze/scripts/export_ll_policy.py --checkpoint PATH/model.pt
./isaaclab.sh train --task Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-v0 --viz none
./isaaclab.sh play --task Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-HL-Play-v0 --viz none
./isaaclab.sh play --task Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Play-v0 --viz none
./isaaclab.sh play --task Nepher-Go2-LidarMaze-Planner-Envhub-Play-v0 --video --num_envs 60
```

Optional drawings, each off by default: `env.vis_lidar_beams=true`, `env.vis_lidar_hits=true`, `env.vis_start_goal=true`. Do not combine `--video` on the EnvHub play task with `--viz none`.
